verdict.rationale: Ramp documents international wires for bill payments as free ('Unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires'), which covers sending money abroad and implies a clear no-fee position. Its API schemas reference currencies like EUR and JPY, but it explicitly cautions that a currency in a schema does not mean every payment method supports it, so paying vendors in their local currency is not clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of local-currency (non-USD) payouts, supported currency/country list, FX rate and markup disclosure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees

citations.quote: Unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments
Standard currencies such as USD, EUR, and JPY use ISO 4217 codes.
Create approved bills via the API, attach documents, choose a payment method, and pay vendors end-to-end
